description_en: Creates a Hologres instance in the specified region
kebab_example: aliyun hologram create-instance --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --zone-id cn-hangzhou-h --vpc-id vpc-t4netc3y5xxxx --vswitch-id vsw-2vccsiymtxxxxxx --resource-group-id example-string --instance-name my_holo --instance-type Standard --cpu 64 --storage-size 500 --cold-storage-size 500 --gateway-count 4 --charge-type PostPaid --auto-pay true --pricing-cycle Month --duration 2 --auto-renew false --leader-instance-id hgpostcn-cn-lbj3aworq112 --initial-databases chatbot --enable-serverless-computing true --storage-type redundant --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateInstance

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable automatic payment. Valid values:

true (default): Automatic payment is enabled.

false: An order is generated, but no payment is made.

If your account balance is insufficient, set the `autoPay` parameter to `false`. When an unpaid order is generated, log on to the Expenses and Costs console to pay for the order
parameters.help_zh:
是否自动支付，默认为true。取值：
true：自动支付。
false：只生成订单，不支付。
默认值为true。如果您的支付方式余额不足，可以将参数AutoPay设置为false，此时会生成未支付订单，您可以登录费用与成本自行支付
parameters.name: auto_pay

parameters.help_en:
Specifies whether to enable auto-renewal. Valid values:

true: Auto-renewal is enabled.

false (default): Auto-renewal is disabled
parameters.help_zh:
是否开启按月自动续费，默认值为false。取值：
true：开启。
false：不开启
parameters.name: auto_renew

parameters.help_en:
The billing method. Valid values:

PrePaid: Subscription.

PostPaid: Pay-as-you-go.

This parameter is ignored for shared instances. Shared instances use defined specifications and the default billing method is pay-as-you-go
parameters.help_zh:
付费类型。取值：
PrePaid：包年包月。
PostPaid: 按量付费。
Shared实例类型会忽略该参数。Shared是一种固定规格类型，收费类型默认为PostPaid
parameters.name: charge_type

parameters.help_en:
The cold storage capacity of the instance. Unit: GB.

This parameter is ignored for pay-as-you-go (PostPaid) instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例低频存储空间。单位：GB。
按量付费（PostPaid）实例会忽略此参数
parameters.name: cold_storage_size

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. Valid values:

32 vCPUs and 128 GB of memory (2 compute nodes)

64 vCPUs and 256 GB of memory (4 compute nodes)

96 vCPUs and 384 GB of memory (6 compute nodes)

128 vCPUs and 512 GB of memory (8 compute nodes)

and so on.

Specify the number of vCPUs.

To purchase an instance with more than 1,024 vCPUs, submit a ticket.

You do not need to specify the instance type for a shared instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例规格。取值：
32核128 GB（计算节点数量：2）
64核256 GB（计算节点数量：4）
96核384 GB（计算节点数量：6）
128核512 GB（计算节点数量：8）
等


填写核数即可。
购买1024以上规格实例请提交工单申请。
Shared实例类型无需指定规格
parameters.name: cpu

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration, such as two months.

Specify this parameter only for subscription instances
parameters.help_zh:
购买周期。比如购买2个月。
若付费类型为PostPaid，则无需指定
parameters.name: duration

parameters.help_en: Specifies whether to enable Serverless Computing
parameters.help_zh: 是否开启ServerlessComputing
parameters.name: enable_serverless_computing

parameters.help_en:
The number of gateways. Valid values: [2, 50].

You must specify this parameter only for virtual warehouse instances
parameters.help_zh:
网关数量，取值[2, 50]。

只有Warehouse类型需要指定该参数
parameters.name: gateway_count

parameters.help_en: The initial database
parameters.help_zh: 初始数据库
parameters.name: initial_databases

parameters.help_en: The instance name. The name must be 2 to 64 characters in length. A letter is counted as one character
parameters.help_zh: 实例名称(2-64个字符，一个中文/字母算一个字符)
parameters.name: instance_name

parameters.help_en:
The instance type. Valid values:

Standard: General-purpose instance.

Follower: Read-only secondary instance.

Warehouse: Virtual warehouse instance.

Shared: Shared instance.

Serverless: Serverless instance
parameters.help_zh:
实例类型。取值：
Standard：通用型。
Follower：只读从实例。
Warehouse：计算组型。
Shared：共享型。
Severless：Serverless型
parameters.name: instance_type

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the primary instance. This parameter is required for secondary instances.

The primary and secondary instances must meet the following conditions:

The primary instance is in the Running state.

The primary and secondary instances are in the same region and zone.

They are in the same zone.

The primary instance has less than 10 secondary instances.

The primary and secondary instances belong to the same Alibaba Cloud account
parameters.help_zh:
主实例Id，Follower类型必填。

主从实例必须满足以下条件：
主实例"运行正常"(Running)状态
主从实例regionId一致
主从实例zoneId一致
主实例已绑定的从实例数少于10个
主从实例属于同一个主账号
parameters.name: leader_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing cycle. Valid values:

Month: The instance is billed on a monthly basis.

Hour: The instance is billed on an hourly basis.

Subscription instances support only `Month`.

Pay-as-you-go instances support only `Hour`.

For shared instances, the value is automatically set to `Hour`
parameters.help_zh:
计费周期。取值：
Month：按月计费。
Hour：按小时计费。

PrePaid 只支持Month
PostPaid 只支持Hour
Shared类型自动设为Hour，无需指定
parameters.name: pricing_cycle

parameters.help_en: The region ID. For more information, see <props="china">Endpoints (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/hologres/developer-reference/api-hologram-2022-06-01-endpoint)</props><props="intl">Endpoints (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/hologres/developer-reference/api-hologram-2022-06-01-endpoint)</props>
parameters.help_zh:
地域Id. 可前往<props="china">服务接入点 (https://help.aliyun.com/zh/hologres/developer-reference/api-hologram-2022-06-01-endpoint)</props>
<props="intl">服务接入点 (https://www.alibabacloud.com/help/zh/hologres/developer-reference/api-hologram-2022-06-01-endpoint)</props>
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The resource group. If you leave this parameter empty, the default resource group for your account is used
parameters.help_zh: 资源组。若为空，则为账号默认资源组
parameters.name: resource_group_id

parameters.help_en:
The standard storage capacity of the instance. Unit: GB.

This parameter is ignored for pay-as-you-go (PostPaid) instances
parameters.help_zh:
实例标准存储空间。单位：GB。
按量付费实例（PostPaid）会忽略此参数
parameters.name: storage_size

parameters.help_en: The storage class
parameters.help_zh: 存储类型
parameters.name: storage_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the vSwitch. The vSwitch must be in the same zone as the instance
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟专有交换机，其所在zoneId必须与实例一致
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en: The ID of the virtual private cloud (VPC). The VPC must be in the same region as the instance
parameters.help_zh: 虚拟专有网络，其所在regionId必须与实例一致
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en: The zone ID
parameters.help_zh: 可用区Id。参考“使用说明“
parameters.name: zone_id

Success.description_en:
Indicates whether the instance was created.

true: The instance was created.

false: The instance failed to be created
Success.description_zh:
创建是否成功。  
true：创建成功。
false：创建失败
